title: Comfort with room for living

captions.energy: Subjecting help to fixed domestic rules
captions.emotions: Feeling warmth and enough around you

meaning: Your domestic support brings warmth when supportive actions allow actual needs and order serves care for both.
text: Home can support your hope for a good shared life through very small actions. In the physical position of Muladhara, the Star works this way: sharing what is available, easing an evening and preserving an opportunity to recover. The Emperor in energy can make such help too dependent on rules. The Empress in emotions wants warmth and a feeling of having enough. Comfort is prepared, yet it may only be used in an established way although today’s need is slightly different.

For example, you free a comfortable place beside the window to make resting at home more pleasant. A throw and small table appear, but cups are allowed only in the kitchen and the throw must immediately be folded. The evening becomes careful observance of order. **Comfort becomes support when it can be used without continual inspection.** Looking after belongings is quite compatible with being able to settle in without interrupting every peaceful moment for a perfect appearance.

The difficulty is treating flexibility as the beginning of disorder and tightening rules exactly where rest is wanted. A supportive gesture loses some of its meaning: there is a good place, but little freedom to inhabit it. Support grows when conditions are understood by both and proportionate to actual inconvenience. Warmth does not require abandoning order, but it does need room for ordinary life.
